notes.title: Sound settings unresponsiveness bug fixed
notes.content:
Thank you for following Isoland 2 - Ashes of Time. This update features the following optimizations:
1.  Fixed a bug where the sound settings were unresponsive
2.  Improved the quality of Steam screenshots
3.  Optimized the pen tablet drawing function

tags.bug: 1.  Fixed a bug where the sound settings were unresponsive
